text:
evan: Quick thought : tiny 'cost blip' indicator inline in model list. shows tokens, cache credits, est $/1k for 1h. minimal UI, low noise.

maya: sounds useful. product wants raw counts + normalized. default to normalized.

hiro: main infra concern: don't hit CH per page load. sampling complicates numbers.

metrics-bot: FYI model_burn_agg rollup=5s, sampling_rate=0.1-0.2 for high-card tenants.

maya: show a confidence microbadge (pattern+color) if sample_fraction < 0.25. tooltip: "estimate based on x% sampled telemetry".

ev an: also flag if tenant is quota-limited; otherwise numbers look wrong.

ops-bot: router exports quota_events per tenant/min. join in streaming job.

hiro: backend sketch: streaming upserts -> redis hash keyed by tenant:model, TTL 30s. console backend reads once per session. API: 
GET /internal/console/v1/cost_blip?tenant=acme&model=fast-1&window=1h
response: model, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, cost_per_1k_usd, sample_fraction, quota_limited

maya: protect render SLA <200ms. server-side render the pill and debounce reads (30s/session). fallback to stale values with a small "stale" chevron.

ev an: accessibility: confidence badge must not rely on color only. use patterns.

hiro: reconcile plan: nightly batch writes authoritative numbers to billing store so console can link to invoice view for audits.

ops-bot: risk: if many clients expand the hover we could create spikes. mitigate by caching hover details in console backend and rate-limit per-tenant.

metrics-bot: note: add sample_fraction to response so UI can gray low-confidence rows.

maya: rollout: internal preview toggle, track expand CTR and incidents.

ev an: I'll write a short RFC. hiro prototype endpoint + streaming job. maya mock UI states. thanks! :thumbsup:
